import json, sys
from importlib.metadata import distribution, version
import latent_anything
recorded_names = ['huggingface-hub', 'numpy', 'scikit-learn', 'tokenizers', 'torch', 'transformers']
versions = {name: version(name) for name in recorded_names}
dist = distribution("latent-anything")
direct_url = dist.read_text("direct_url.json")
editable = False
if direct_url:
    editable = bool(json.loads(direct_url).get("dir_info", {}).get("editable"))
print("@@JSON@@" + json.dumps({
    "executable": sys.executable,
    "prefix": sys.prefix,
    "python": sys.version.split()[0],
    "latent_file": latent_anything.__file__,
    "sys_path": sys.path,
    "editable": editable,
    "versions": versions,
    "torch_module_version": __import__("torch").__version__,
}))
